copy.caption: James Marsden dominated social media buzz after Disney and Marvel Studios launched the final “Avengers: Doomsday” trailer. Marsden event got to recite his character’s iconic line: “To me, my X-Men!”

story.title: ‘To Me, My X-Men’: James Marsden Says It Was ‘Important’ for Cyclops to Be a Leader in ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ After Taking a ‘Back Seat to Wolverine’
story.summary: James Marsden dominated social media buzz after Disney and Marvel Studios launched the final “Avengers: Doomsday” trailer, which ended on the viral moment of Marsden’s Cyclops uniting the X-Men and Avengers in battle against Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom.
